notes:
Inbound SMB lead from mobile social gaming app. Primary ask: replace homegrown chat bot with moderated LLM-powered chat (player-to-bot and bot-assisted replies). Key constraints: sub-100ms median token latency for short messages, ability to rate-limit and throttle, and integrated abuse/spam controls. Wants Hosted API self-serve trial first — low friction SDK + websocket/streaming support important. Quoted: 'We need something plug-and-play that won't blow our latency budgets and can auto-mitigate spam waves.'

Discovery notes (shorthand):
- Workloads: bursts around new-patch / events, steady baseline 20-50 req/s, peak 200-400 req/s for chat message gen (small prompts, <128 tokens).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants to measure tokens/unit cost; likely start with $5k-$25k ARR if latency/SLOs met.
- Models: prefer smaller low-latency models (local quantized variants ok) but initial ask is Hosted (public cloud) for speed to market.
- Routing/fallback: want fallback to cheaper model when saturated, and explicit rate-limit responses for UX.
- Security/compliance: need audit logs, retention controls, API key rotation; SSO not required for now.
- POC plan: provide trial keys, sample SDK snippet + websocket example, run synthetic traffic test (50-100 req/s) during next week.
- Stakeholders: Sam Chen (CTO), Lina Park (Head of Platform), Product manager: Ravi Iyer.
- Blockers: internal budget cycle mid-Apr, need demo of abuse handling (rate limits + toxicity filter) and latency proof.

Links: pricing deck (drive://QuickPlay/Redwood_pricing_quickstart_v1.pdf), recorded call id ff_4928ab, jira GP-1723 tracking initial integration questions.
